text: Azure Blob Storage vs Data Lake Gen2
code:
# Connect to Azure Blob Storage
from azure.storage.blob import (
    BlobServiceClient
)
client = BlobServiceClient\
    .from_connection_string(conn_str)
container = client\
    .get_container_client('raw-data')
subtext: Use Blob for unstructured files. Choose Data Lake Gen2 when you need hierarchical namespaces and fine-grained ACLs for analytics workloads.

text: Data is the new oil — but only if you know how to refine it.

code:
# Bad: collect() on large datasets
df.collect()  # OOM risk!

# Good: use show() or write
df.show(20, truncate=False)
df.write.parquet('s3://bucket/out')
subtext: Never call collect() on large DataFrames. Use write.parquet() or write.delta() to persist results efficiently.
